title: 利润翻5倍：股价为何不涨反跌，AI芯片需求强劲却遭抛售
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: semiconductor companies are posting triple digit earnings growth and hyping huge demand for all things AI. So why are their share prices sliding?
segments.zh: 半导体公司公布三位数盈利增长，并大力宣传AI需求旺盛。那为何股价却在下跌？

segments.en: Let's take high-necks as an example. Earnings are 557% margins over 80% and yet the stock drops 7.5%. US stocks have been trading very similarly with
segments.zh: 以高盛为例，盈利增长557%，利润率超80%，但股价却下跌7.5%。美国市场表现也类似，微芯科技在财报后也出现类似跌幅。

segments.en: micro-onsing a similar fall after earnings. One reason expectations are sky-high analysts have 45 buys and zero sells on high-necks with consensus target price over double
segments.zh: 原因之一是预期过高：分析师对高盛有45个买入评级，零卖出，目标价共识是当前股价的两倍多。

segments.en: where the stock price is trading at the moment. It will take a lot to buy investors from here.
segments.zh: 从当前价位，要说服市场参与者买入需要付出很多。

segments.en: Another reason? Crowded positioning. Most people are aware that AI demand is booming this year yet Chinese disruption looms on the horizon. Uncertainty is rising and investors are less sure
segments.zh: 另一个原因是仓位拥挤。多数人知道今年AI需求旺盛，但中国市场的干扰隐约可见。不确定性上升，市场参与者对未来更不确定。

segments.en: about what the future brings. So how will market stabilize? Companies will have to provide better visibility into 27 and 28 and investors will need to do far more homework
segments.zh: 那么市场如何稳定？公司需要提供对27年和28年更清晰的展望，市场参与者也需要对科技交易演变做更多功课。

segments.en: about how the tech trade evolves. The AI trade is no longer easy money.
